column1: # Payloads for the audit-log JSON gate (build_test.sh gate 52).
# Columns: expected verdict, SQL expression (used verbatim) passed as payload_json to
# fractal_audit_log. OK: the entry is accepted (returns 0). BAD: it is refused (NULL),
# so nothing malformed or spliced can reach the chain record.
# Only unambiguous cases are listed: the validator is structural, not a full RFC 8259
# parser (it does not check key/colon placement, leading zeros or string escapes).
